subject: Onboarding evidence & DPA scoping — PII handling flow and access matrix
messages:
From: Jade Reynolds <jade.reynolds@medinova.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Porter <alex.porter@medinova.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MediNova onboarding — initial evidence request and scoping questions

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the demo last week. As part of MediNova's procurement & security review we need a compact set of artifacts to complete our DPIA and legal review before we can finalize the DPA. Could you share the following by EOD Wednesday (PST)?

- A high-level dataflow diagram that shows where PII enters Redwood services and which components hold persistent copies (short-lived caches vs. durable storage).
- Current access matrix for PII (roles, privileged vs. non-privileged, justifications).
- Any excerpts of KMS/HSM attestation and where keys are stored (regional scope).
- List of subprocessors involved in storage / backups / telemetry and whether any are outside the US.

If easier, a short pointer doc + attachments is fine — we don't need full audit bundles yet. Also flag anything you consider confidential.

Best,
Jade Reynolds
Privacy & Security PM
MediNova
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Jade Reynolds <jade.reynolds@medinova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MediNova onboarding — initial evidence request and scoping questions

Hi Jade — thanks for the clear list. Putting Mina and Marissa on this thread to pull the artifacts together. Quick answers up front:

- We can provide a single-page dataflow SVG (with redacted component telemetry IDs) + an annotated CSV access matrix.
- KMS attestation excerpt is available; full attestation can be escalated under an NDA if required. Keys are customer-segmented with regional partitions (US, EU).
- Current subprocessors that handle storage and backups: ObjectStoreCo (US), MirrorOps (US), and MetricsFlow (US processing only). No storage subprocessors outside the US for the hosted account model; Dedicated/Private can vary and we'll call that out.

Action plan:
1) Mina will attach the dataflow diagram and the access matrix draft.
2) Marissa will confirm the subprocessors list and add short descriptions.
3) I'll follow up with the KMS excerpt and a short note on cross-border transfer policy.

We'll include a Drive link and a Jira ticket for tracking. If you want this as a zipped evidence package, say the word.

Thanks — tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
https://redwood.com/
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jade Reynolds <jade.reynolds@medinova.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MediNova onboarding — initial evidence request and scoping questions

Hi Jade — attaching the requested artifacts below and with notes inline.

Attachments (stubs):
- redwood_pii_dataflow_v1.svg (single-page view: ingestion -> preprocessing -> cache -> serving runtime -> logs -> optional long-term metrics). Persistent PII is only written to customer-specific storage when customers opt into data persistence; by default we keep ephemeral KV caches for inference at TTL=1h.
- access_matrix_20260830.csv (columns: role, resource, privilege, justification, last_review). Key roles: infra_admin (privileged, justif: infra ops), model_ops (limited, justif: KV cache handling), se_engineer (support access via guarded sessions).
- kms_attestation_excerpt.pdf (redacted — includes key custody locations and CA signatures; full doc requires NDA or contract appendix).

Notes:
- Subprocessors: ObjectStoreCo (US) — stores customer snapshots for Dedicated if enabled; MirrorOps (US) — disaster recovery replication; MetricsFlow (US) — aggregates anonymized telemetry (we do not send PII fields to MetricsFlow).
- Cross-border transfers: hosted accounts are processed in the region selected; for MediNova's US region no onward EU transfers occur by default. If you require specific EEA-only processing, we can propose a Dedicated/Private deployment and capture that in the DPA.

Link to artifacts & tracking: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aXy_example_dataflow
Jira tracking: SEC-4321 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-4321)

If you want a short cover letter for procurement summarizing these three artifacts, I can prepare one.

Thanks,
Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Privacy & Compliance Analyst, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jade Reynolds <jade.reynolds@medinova.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MediNova onboarding — initial evidence request and scoping questions

Jade — two small follow-ups after reviewing the attachments:

1) Can you confirm whether your DPIA expects enumerated field-level samples (e.g., which PII fields you consider 'sensitive') or if a role-based description is sufficient? We can produce a short mapping doc to your field names, but that takes an extra day.

2) On subprocessors: we listed the storage and telemetry processors. If you have a procurement template that requires commercial contact points for each subprocessor, send it over — we'll add a contact and a short SLA note for backups only.

I've also put the DocuSign link for the initial Redwood DPA (template) in case you want simultaneous contract review: https://app.docusign.com/some-dpa-sign-url

If you prefer a combined zip, Mina and I can deliver it by EOD today.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Jade Reynolds <jade.reynolds@medinova.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 17:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MediNova onboarding — initial evidence request and scoping questions

Thanks all, this is extremely helpful. A couple quick clarifications so the legal team can sign off:

- A role-based mapping is fine for now; we'll follow up if field-level mapping is required.
- Please include the short SLA note for backups and a commercial contact for ObjectStoreCo and MirrorOps.
- For the KMS excerpt: legal prefers the attestation and confirmation that key custodianship is under Redwood (not third-party-managed HSM) for the default hosted model. If you can state that explicitly in a short paragraph, that should suffice.

If you can bundle the access_matrix_20260830.csv, the dataflow SVG, the KMS paragraph, and the subprocessor contact list into a single zip and drop it into the Drive link you sent, we'll route to legal tomorrow. We'll plan a verbal go/no-go on the DPA on Monday after they review.

Best,
Jade

--
Jade Reynolds
Privacy & Security PM, MediNova
